body: Version bumps are small and patch-first: each release bumps the PATCH (0.3.0 -> 0.3.1 -> 0.3.2), never jumps the minor per batch of features as 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 -> 0.3.0 did. A minor or major bump only when the user asks for it. Chrome Web Store versions can never go down, so the next release continues from the last uploaded version (0.3.0 -> 0.3.1); propose the exact version and ask before bumping. User, 2026-10-10: 'why we publish like 0.3.0 this is wrong we should have 0.1.0, 0.1.1 etc'.
